calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Dodo Brands
calls.summary: The company is transitioning from a legacy A/B testing system to GrowthBook's self-hosted platform to improve scalability and flexibility. Currently, there are 20-30 active users, with plans to grow to about 100 users across two brands. The previous systems faced challenges in user segmentation and lacked the necessary advanced statistical tools for effective experimentation. GrowthBook, chosen for its open-source nature, will ensure data privacy by running SQL queries directly on Databricks. The enterprise features required include sticky bucketing and governance tools. Pricing considerations revolve around a minimum package for 50 users and 100 experiments per year, with customized quotes available. The decision is expected to finalize within the current quarter, focusing on scenario sharing and technical validation.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, self-hosted, enterprise license, A/B testing, feature flagging, event analytics
